interface.name: jwm_remote_viewer_handoff_manager_v1

description.summary: explicit trusted local viewer focus transaction

interface.description: JWM udev only. No remote authorization is granted. The authenticated viewer must independently obtain both peer permissions and use no more than its original remaining remote lifetime. Sandboxed clients, foreign surfaces and non-toplevel surfaces are denied. One attempt per surface, one live session per seat.

interface.name: jwm_remote_viewer_handoff_session_v1
interface.description: TTL is fixed at creation, 1 through 30000 ms. Sequence starts at one, contiguous and at most 60000. Enter consumes an actual fresh wl_pointer enter serial while physically clean. Transition is emitted before compositor focus changes; active follows actual focus and shortcut inhibition. Exit always releases, including inside the surface, but another entry needs a new pointer enter serial. Exiting while keys are held defers local focus restoration until all physical keys release; no held-key replay. Arbitrary focus loss, lock, unmap, expiry and emergency escape revoke permanently.

arg.name: reason
arg.summary: 1 denied, 2 lifetime or surface invalid, 3 unexpected focus change, 4 escape, 5 sequence or unclean input
